name: simplefs
description: Minimalist, high-performance file server with HTMX, Tailwind CSS and Go

scripts.build:vendor: mkdir -p ./static/vendor/ && curl -sL https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@1.9.10 -o ./static/vendor/htmx.min.js && curl -sL https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/styles/github-dark.min.css -o ./static/vendor/github-dark.min.css && curl -sL https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/highlight.min.js -o ./static/vendor/highlight.min.js && curl -sL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js -o ./static/vendor/marked.min.js && curl -sL https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dompurify/3.0.9/purify.min.js -o ./static/vendor/purify.min.js && cp -r ./node_modules/@fontsource/inter ./static/vendor/fontsource-inter && cp -r ./node_modules/material-symbols ./static/vendor/material-symbols
scripts.build: pnpm run build:vendor && pnpm run build:css && pnpm run build:go
